upload_to_s3.minio_branch: upload ExtraArgs {ACL: public-read, ContentType: application/zip}; presign via endpoint built from AWS_S3_URL_PROTOCOL + AWS_S3_CUSTOM_DOMAIN minus '/uploads'.
upload_to_s3.standard_branch: upload ExtraArgs {ContentType: application/zip} (NO ACL); region_name iff AWS_S3_ENDPOINT_URL unset.
upload_to_s3.row_lifecycle: ExporterHistory.objects.get(token=token_id); presigned_url truthy -> url+status=completed+key saved (update_fields status,url,key); falsy -> status=failed. TODO at :41: migrate to file-asset storage.

issue_export_task.status_flow: processing on entry; invalid provider (DataExporter ValueError) -> failed + reason; success path leaves status to upload_to_s3 (completed/failed); broad except -> failed + str(e) + log_exception.
issue_export_task.issue_filter: workspace__id + project_id__in + member is_active + project.archived_at null (all via project__project_projectmember).
issue_export_task.filenames: multiple -> one file per project '{slug}-{project_id}'; single -> '{slug}-{workspace_id}'. exporter.export(filename, qs).

delete_old_s3_link.filter_sql: SELECT "exporters"."key", "exporters"."id" FROM "exporters" WHERE ("exporters"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "exporters"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "exporters"."created_at" <= 2026-09-20 06:00:00+00:00) ORDER BY "exporters"."created_at" DESC
delete_old_s3_link.predicate: url IS NOT NULL AND created_at <= now()-8d; .values_list(key, id).
delete_old_s3_link.s3_loop: One boto3 client for the whole run (MINIO iff settings.USE_MINIO). Per row: delete_object(Bucket, Key=file_name) ONLY iff file_name truthy (the MINIO/non-MINIO delete branches at :48-51 are IDENTICAL calls). Then ExporterHistory filter(id).update(url=None) unconditionally — even when file_name was falsy.

analytic.csv_note: csv.writer QUOTE_ALL + CRLF lineterminator; sanitize_csv_row prefixes "'" to strings starting with = + - @ TAB CR LF (OWASP CSV injection).
analytic.segmented_traps: x_axis 'state_id' is NOT in row_mapping (keys are 'state__name' etc.) so the header falls back to 'X-Axis'. Missing segment cell renders as the STRING '0' (:217). segment_zero order = first-seen order over set() (NONDETERMINISTIC across runs).
analytic.segmented_module_bug_note: At :278-282 MODULE segment headers are resolved against label_details (not module_details) with module-id keys, so they never match and stay raw. Port as-is.
analytic.nonsegmented_note: Row value = data[0].get('count'|'estimate'); only the FIRST distribution element is read. Unresolved ids stay raw ('u-9').

detail_sql.assignee: SELECT DISTINCT ON ("issue_assignees"."assignee_id") "users"."display_name", "users"."first_name", "users"."last_name", "issue_assignees"."assignee_id", CASE WHEN "users"."avatar_asset_id" IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT((/api/assets/v2/static/)::text, (CONCAT(("users"."avatar_asset_id")::text, (/)::text))::text) WHEN "users"."avatar_asset_id" IS NULL THEN "users"."avatar" ELSE NULL END AS "assignees__avatar_url" FROM "issues" LEFT OUTER JOIN "states" ON ("issues"."state_id" = "states"."id") INNER JOIN "projects" ON ("issues"."project_id" = "projects"."id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "issue_assignees" ON ("issues"."id" = "issue_assignees"."issue_id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "users" ON ("issue_assignees"."assignee_id" = "users"."id") INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("issues"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND NOT ("states"."group" = triage AND "states"."group" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("issues"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("projects"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("issues"."is_draft") AND ("users"."avatar" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."avatar_asset_id" IS NOT NULL) AND "workspaces"."slug" = ws-slug) ORDER BY "issue_assignees"."assignee_id" ASC
detail_sql.label: SELECT DISTINCT ON ("issue_labels"."label_id") "issue_labels"."label_id", "labels"."color", "labels"."name" FROM "issues" INNER JOIN "issue_labels" ON ("issues"."id" = "issue_labels"."issue_id") INNER JOIN "labels" ON ("issue_labels"."label_id" = "labels"."id") INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("issues"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "issue_labels"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "issue_labels"."label_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."slug" = ws-slug) ORDER BY "issue_labels"."label_id" ASC
detail_sql.state: SELECT DISTINCT ON ("issues"."state_id") "issues"."state_id", "states"."name", "states"."color" FROM "issues" LEFT OUTER JOIN "states" ON ("issues"."state_id" = "states"."id") INNER JOIN "projects" ON ("issues"."project_id" = "projects"."id") INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("issues"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND NOT ("states"."group" = triage AND "states"."group" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("issues"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("projects"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("issues"."is_draft") AND "workspaces"."slug" = ws-slug) ORDER BY "issues"."state_id" ASC
detail_sql.module: SELECT DISTINCT ON ("module_issues"."module_id") "module_issues"."module_id", "modules"."name" FROM "issues" LEFT OUTER JOIN "states" ON ("issues"."state_id" = "states"."id") INNER JOIN "projects" ON ("issues"."project_id" = "projects"."id") INNER JOIN "module_issues" ON ("issues"."id" = "module_issues"."issue_id") INNER JOIN "modules" ON ("module_issues"."module_id" = "modules"."id") INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("issues"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND NOT ("states"."group" = triage AND "states"."group" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("issues"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("projects"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("issues"."is_draft") AND "module_issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "module_issues"."module_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."slug" = ws-slug) ORDER BY "module_issues"."module_id" ASC
detail_sql.cycle: SELECT DISTINCT ON ("cycle_issues"."cycle_id") "cycle_issues"."cycle_id", "cycles"."name" FROM "issues" LEFT OUTER JOIN "states" ON ("issues"."state_id" = "states"."id") INNER JOIN "projects" ON ("issues"."project_id" = "projects"."id") INNER JOIN "cycle_issues" ON ("issues"."id" = "cycle_issues"."issue_id") INNER JOIN "cycles" ON ("cycle_issues"."cycle_id" = "cycles"."id") INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("issues"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND NOT ("states"."group" = triage AND "states"."group" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("issues"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("projects"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ("issues"."is_draft") AND "cycle_issues"."cycle_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cycle_issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."slug" = ws-slug) ORDER BY "cycle_issues"."cycle_id" ASC

analytic.detail_notes: assignee requires avatar OR avatar_asset non-null; avatar_url is a CASE (asset -> CONCAT('/api/assets/v2/static/', id, '/'), else avatar). label/state/module/cycle use DISTINCT ON + ORDER BY the distinct key. All read through Issue.issue_objects (soft-delete/triage/archived/draft scope).
analytic.analytic_export_task: issue_filters(data,'POST') + workspace__slug filter; x/y/segment from data (default False); build_graph_plot; key = 'count' iff y is issue_count else 'estimate'; detail querysets fetched ONLY for axes in use (else {}); segment truthy -> segmented rows else non-segmented; csv; send_export_email; broad except -> log_exception, return None.
analytic.export_analytics_to_csv_email: rows=[headers]+[[item.get(k,'') for k in keys] for item in data]; csv; send_export_email(email, slug, ...).
analytic.send_export_email: subject 'Your Export is ready'; template emails/exports/analytics.html rendered with {}; plain-text via generate_plain_text_from_html; SMTP connection from get_email_configuration() with use_tls/use_ssl = (value == '1') STRING compare; attach (f'{slug}-analytics.csv', csv bytes); send(fail_silently=False). csv_buffer.seek(0) before read.
